answer: SELECT DISTINCT p.Description FROM transactions_1k t JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID WHERE g.Country = 'CZE';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT y.CustomerID) FROM yearmonth y JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR' AND y.Consumption > 1000;

WITH cust_totals AS (
  SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
  FROM customers c
  JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
  GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
seg_min AS (
  SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_total
  FROM cust_totals
  GROUP BY Segment
),
seg_avg AS (
  SELECT ct.Segment,
         SUM(ct.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
  FROM cust_totals ct
  JOIN seg_min sm ON ct.Segment = sm.Segment AND ct.total_consumption = sm.min_total
  GROUP BY ct.Segment
)
SELECT
  (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment='SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment='LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
  (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment='LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment='KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
  (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment='KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment='SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE Segment='SME' AND Currency='CZK') - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE Segment='SME' AND Currency='EUR') AS diff;

SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.Currency='EUR' THEN t.CustomerID END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT t.CustomerID) AS pct_eur FROM transactions_1k t JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25';
SELECT DISTINCT g.Country FROM yearmonth y JOIN transactions_1k t ON y.CustomerID = t.CustomerID JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID WHERE y.Date = '201306';
note: transactions_1k only contains transactions dated 2012-08-23 through 2012-08-26 (no June 2013 rows), so filtering transactions_1k.Date directly returns nothing. Followed the evidence's instruction to derive year/month from the yearmonth table's YYYYMM-formatted Date, joining yearmonth (filtered to 201306) to transactions_1k by CustomerID to reach the gas stations.
